featured_reviews.name: anil mahindrakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
As someone who is always on the hunt for great desserts, Pinka Bake House was such a pleasant surprise. Being a pure vegetarian bakery, I wasn’t sure what to expect, but their cheesecake and tiramisu completely won me over.

The cheesecake was incredibly creamy, rich, and perfectly balanced—not overly sweet, which is rare. Every bite felt fresh and indulgent. The tiramisu was equally impressive, with beautiful coffee notes and a light, velvety texture that kept me going back for more.

What I loved most was that these desserts didn’t feel like “good for a veg bakery”—they were genuinely outstanding on their own. If you’re a cheesecake or tiramisu lover and prefer pure vegetarian desserts, Pinka Bake House is absolutely worth trying.

Definitely one of my favorite dessert discoveries in Mumbai. 🍰✨

featured_reviews.name: Author Kailash amesur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pinka Cheese Cake Stall is a hidden gem that I stumbled upon during my recent outing. Their cheesecakes are a true delight for the taste buds. The range of flavors they offer is impressive, and each bite reveals a perfect balance of creaminess and sweetness.

What sets Pinka Cheese Cake apart is not just their delectable cakes but also the attention to detail in presentation. Each slice is a work of art that shows the passion and dedication that goes into crafting these desserts.

The stall itself has a charming and inviting ambiance, adding to the overall experience of indulging in their cheesecakes. The friendly staff enhances the visit, providing excellent customer service and making you feel right at home.

Whether you're a cheesecake enthusiast or simply looking to satisfy your sweet cravings, Pinka Cheese Cake Stall is a must-visit. I highly recommend trying their various flavors to experience a delightful symphony of taste in every bite. This place has definitely earned a spot on my list of favorites, and I can't wait to go back for more.

featured_reviews.name: Mehvish Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday I visited Pinka Bake House, a delightful home bakery located in Powai, Mumbai. Known as Mumbai's first cheesecake stall.

Upon my friends' enthusiastic recommendations about their cheesecakes, we decided to sample a variety: Nutella Cheesecake, Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake, Blueberry Cheesecake, and a Black Forest Mousse. The Nutella and Lotus Biscoff cheesecakes were rich and delectable, but the Blueberry Cheesecake truly stood out—it was exceptional! I'd rate the Blueberry a stellar 100/10, the Nutella an 8.5/10, the Lotus a 9/10, and the creamy Black Forest Mousse a solid 8/10.

The portions were generous, and we couldn't finish everything. The kind lady serving us graciously packed the remaining cheesecakes for us to enjoy at home. The Blueberry Cheesecake has certainly won my heart. I'm looking forward to returning for more!
